personal.name: Jinwon Lee
personal.title: SRE Engineer · Platform Engineer
personal.motto: Make it work, then make it better.

summary: I'm currently working as a Site Reliability Engineer at Samsung Electronics, with 8 years of experience as a developer. My background spans distributed AI systems, AI applications, infrastructure automation, and DevOps.

I enjoy making life easier for developers by automating systems in Linux environments, and I'm always curious to dive deeper into how systems work. I'm also quick to explore and adopt new technologies when they can help solve real problems.
